answer: Anti-Sybil via dual-channel activation: the network sends two fresh nonces, one through each of two independent message providers the identity registered. The agent must sign both nonces so auditors can match each provider's delivery signal against its logs. Extra identities each need two paid, separately owned inboxes on a reef of unrelated providers; one shared inbox fails the check. Cloning cannot reroute someone else's inbound pulse. Limitation: virtual number farms still exist, so providers should attest account age and reject bulk-created inboxes.
